profile.headline: Software Engineering Lead | Agentic Apps | Cloud | AWS Solutions Architect Certified
profile.summary:
I’m a hands-on staff-level engineering leader who loves turning messy (or not), high-stakes problems into reliable, scalable systems. Recently at SourceScrub, I led a small team building event-driven microservices and CRM integrations. Before that, at Aspen Capital, I designed an AWS-based intelligent document-processing pipeline that automated classification and extraction end-to-end and helped slash customer wait times by half. Earlier, during my Fox/Disney tenure, I partnered with engineering leadership and business stakeholders from several groups across the organization to analyze, coordinate and build enterprise-level systems

Across fintech, SaaS, agriscience, media, and entertainment I’ve mentored engineers, partnered with product/UX/architecture, and shippped dependable platforms using modern patterns, micro services, event-driven, serverless, and agentic apps. I like work that compounds: architecture, delivery and leveled-up teams.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Streamlined fragmented systems, improving maintainability and accelerating delivery.
• Built AI-driven integrations connecting internal data with LLMs to automate key workflows.
• Created a customer health dashboard that reduced support tickets by 30% through proactive issue detection.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · Elasticsearch · .NET · Apache Kafka · Model Context Protocol · C# · Azure · RabbitMQ

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Implemented an Intelligent Document Processing pipeline with AWS ML and NLP services, greatly enhancing customer support efficiency. positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Pulumi · Microservices · PostgreSQL · NestJS · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · Java · Dynamodb · Cdk · React.js · Microsoft SQL Server · Node.js · Cloud Computing · Scrum · Python

positions.description: Designed & built core components microservices for the Steady platform serving a 6 million user base that includes the company’s flagship product and companion data, insights, and workflow solutions.
